initial.chief_complaint: Progressive jaundice, dark stools, lethargy and lightheadedness.

presenting_complaint: Progressive jaundice, dark stools, lethargy and lightheadedness.
history_freetext:
Four days of progressive jaundice and dark stools with lethargy and lightheadedness; no reported bleeding, fever, cough or abdominal pain.
Advanced lung adenocarcinoma with adrenal and subdiaphragmatic metastases; high tumor PD-L1 expression.
First pembrolizumab 400 mg IV dose 14 days before presentation.
Gastritis, hyperlipidemia, previous cholecystectomy; former smoker.
